## About

Kisaki Project is a modular WhatsApp bot built with JavaScript and powered by the Baileys library. It organizes commands and features through a plugin-based architecture, making the project easier to maintain, customize, and extend.

## Features

- 📦 Modular plugin system
- 🤖 WhatsApp Multi-Device support
- ⚡ Command handler
- 🧩 Easy to extend with plugins
- 🛠 Utility modules
- 📁 Organized project structure

## Installation

```bash
npm install
```

```bash
npm start
```
